# class fixtures

- `animals.mmd`, `relations.mmd` and parts of `namespaces.mmd` follow the
  examples in the Mermaid class diagram documentation
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/classDiagram.html), MIT licensed,
  © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `legacy-sample.mmd` is the class sample shipped with mermaid-svg 0.7.0
  (`crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/class.mmd`), MIT licensed.
- `cjk-long.mmd` is written for this crate: CJK names, long members,
  backtick names and an empty class.
